name: Koisuru Scramble: The Otome
source:
Enter (???) Koino, who kept having weird visions of some new thing happening to her life while being late on her first day at Yumenosaki-Cho! While on her way, she takes a shortcut towards the infamous 6-way intersection. Bumping into 4 beautiful mysterious guys, it's up to you to choose her route and future love story!

(From the game's [url=https://mikehan.itch.io/koisuru-scramble]itch.io page[/url])
